title: ORES Wasm Loaders — release registry
description: Independent JSON Schema authority for the loader release registry. Peer of contracts/typespec/main.tsp; neither is generated from the other.

LoaderFramework.description: Which loader adapter owns a release's lifecycle.

EntrypointRole.description: The role a file plays in a release's startup.

AssetStage.description: How eagerly an asset may be prepared before the visitor asks for the app.

ActivationMode.description: What activation does once preparation is complete.

PrepareStage.description: How far preparation is permitted to go. Compilation is optional, never assumed.

WasmRelease.description: One immutable published release of one application.

releaseId.description: Immutable release identifier — also the CDN path segment.

toolchain.description: Toolchain that produced the build, e.g. `flutter 3.35.1` or `wasm-bindgen 0.2.95`.

contractVersion.description: Version of this loader contract the manifest was written against.

baseUrl.description: Absolute or origin-relative base URL of the immutable release directory.

requiresCrossOriginIsolation.description: Flutter's threaded renderer needs cross-origin isolation — most releases do not.

WasmEntrypoint.description: A file a release needs at startup, in the role its build output gives it.

path.description: Path relative to the release baseUrl.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file as served.

WasmAsset.description: Any other asset of the release, tagged with how eagerly it may be prepared.

WasmPreparePolicy.description: The budget and lifecycle a marketing page must respect for this release.

maxPrepareBytes.description: Hard ceiling on bytes preparation may fetch for this release.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent prepare requests for this release.

hostSelector.description: Element id or selector the app mounts into, when activation needs one.
